title: Citadel Policy Gate Simulator
oneLine: Interactive zero-trust policy gate for AI agent tool calls (identity → scope → args → rate → allow/deny).
role: Architect / implementer — Java WebSocket gate, MCP action sandbox, multi-agent orchestration

evidence.label: Java WebSocket gate + Bucket4j rate limit

limitations: Static simulation of authorization rules; does not start Ollama, Java gate, or MCP. Production SANDBOX_DIR anonymized as /sandbox/citadel. Per-persona scopes for design-only agents are least-privilege overlays; Java runtime registers MaKr/SupremeAdvisor/DocDora with shared MCP access.
